steps.name: Tired Spectator
steps.text: (Yawns)

steps.name: Tired Spectator
steps.text: Reynell really knows how to grind gears. A perfectly good art gallery opening and he has to hold it late in the night. Now I'm stuck here, waiting it to finish in the morning.

steps.name: Enthusiastic Spectator
steps.text: I bet Reynell's gonna show us something totally out there, don't you? Why the all-nighter otherwise?

steps.name: Tired Spectator
steps.text: Whatever. I was looking forward to the street art community festival anyway, and that got cancelled for no reason. I've got nowhere else to be.

steps.name: Newbie Investor
steps.text: Reynell's taken the joke too far. Keeping the concrete details of this opening ceremony secret even from high-level partners like us...

steps.name: Newbie Investor
steps.text: Hrmph. I suppose playing to the gallery is his literal job.

steps.name: Seasoned Investor
steps.text: You think of a joke that manages to drive over half of Terra's art investors scrambling to our Bunkerhill City HQ the way they have for the Galería Krysztauowa, and then I'll hear you whine.

spans.text: think of a joke that manages to drive over half of Terra's art investors scrambling to our Bunkerhill City HQ the way they have for the Galería Krysztauowa, and

steps.name: Newbie Investor
steps.text: Yessir...

steps.name: Destitute Noble
steps.text: This Kazimierzian on the brochure... I wonder if his salon really will get a painting or two of mine sold...

steps.name: Haughty Broker
steps.text: This isn't Leithanien. It's all about your story, whether or not it's enough to excite the investors.

steps.name: Destitute Noble
steps.text: Didn't you say to leave all that work to you?

steps.name: Haughty Broker
steps.text: I kept telling you, dye your hair, learn some profanity, dress in tatty clothes, call yourself a rebel against the rotten system of nobility, and they'll all eat it right up. But you won't do any of that. So what can I even say?

steps.name: Haughty Broker
steps.text: I'll give you one last tip. It can't beat a rebel spirit, but there's people who still like the down-and-out noble as a sell. Whether or not it's enough get the investors stirring all comes down to you.

steps.name: PA
steps.text: Ladies and gentlemen, please remain calm. Our opening ceremony is about to commence.

steps.name: PA
steps.text: Repeat. Ladies and gentlemen, please remain calm. Our opening ceremony is about to commence—
Reynell saunters up to the podium erected in the Galería's front plaza.
He calmly surveys the crowd before him a few times, especially the ones in seats closest to him. He confirms to himself that all expected have shown up, and then clears his throat.

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: Everyone, good morning, good afternoon, or good evening—please, take your pick, depending on when you usually sleep.

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: Thank you to everyone who applauded, and thank you to those who didn't. You have, after all, sacrificed your own precious sleep hours to admire this magnificent dawn with me, here in the City of Two Suns.

steps.name: Newbie Investor
steps.text: Hrmph.

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: Thank you for your warm welcome.

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: Thank you for joining me as together, we make history. A small part of it for sure, and possibly of no note to ages far from now, but to all of you here, it will be one you remember for the rest of your lives.

steps.name: Haughty Broker
steps.text: What a smooth talker.

steps.name: Community Resident
steps.text: God save Bolívar, and God save Dossoles ♪

steps.name: Community Resident
steps.text: Our tourists fork out money with their brains full of air ♪

steps.name: Community Resident
steps.text: And the future of this city is one and same ♪

steps.name: Community Singer
steps.text: Hermano, you need some fresh lyrics. Let me accompany for you, I'll write you something a bit more topical.

steps.name: Community Singer
steps.text: God save the Coalition, and God save Kowalski ♪

steps.name: Community Singer
steps.text: The army brass gets in bed with all our slumming millionaires ♪

steps.name: Community Singer
steps.text: On the night when the freak nightmare beast comes to play ♪

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: Everyone, welcome to Dossoles, and welcome to Galería Krysztauowa.

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: Before we get to the main course, I'd like to introduce to you all this event that marks a new age.

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: I'm sure not all of you are for the Galería or the opening ceremony—I'm sure a lot of you sitting there are thinking, 'this is just some forced antic by a Kazimierzian failson.'

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: You would probably care more for something lucrative, so I have it laid out here before you, to satisfy your curiosity and greed.

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: Ladies and gentlemen, please bring out your personal terminals, and raise them high in the air.

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: You proclaim yourselves individuals of refined and discerning taste. You keep up with the trends.

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: Portable terminals. An invention to stand with the greats. An escape for people from the guilt of wasted time, bringing news to every corner of every city, connecting them all together as one.

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: And it's on this rich future vein I'm willing to build a drilling platform in the name of art, and stuff your wallets full with the golden coins and crisp paper bills it gushes forth.

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: It is with great pomp and circumstance that I introduce to you this groundbreaking invention, which will soon make waves throughout the intercity net...

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: The Collector's Virtual Art Piece Project.

steps.name: Community Hawker
steps.text: Bro, how come I've never seen you before?

steps.name: Sly Stranger
steps.text: What are you talking about? I live right upstairs from you!

steps.name: Community Hawker
steps.text: Oh, you're that one guy, uh... Pisto?

steps.name: Sly Stranger
steps.text: Yeah, you got it.

steps.name: Community Hawker
steps.text: Didn't you go to get treated though?

steps.name: Sly Stranger
steps.text: Who cares? Does getting treated give Reynell the right to storm into our neighborhood and wreck our shit?

steps.name: Community Hawker
steps.text: Damn straight!

steps.name: Sly Stranger
steps.text: How about it? Let's head over to that gallery and throw a real party? Should we go big?

steps.name: Community Hawker
steps.text: No duh we go big!

steps.name: Sly Stranger
steps.text: Now you're talking! We can't give a guy like that a single inch!

steps.name: Newbie Investor
steps.text: Collector's Virtual Art Piece? This is what you did with our capital?

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: Ah, think about it. Soon, some artists will cease to work in paints and brushes. They'll sit before their terminals, creating works for the intercity net that you'll be just as able to invest in.

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: I can take any painting in the Galería's collection, make a one-for-one copy of it on the intercity net, and you'll be able to see its every detail on your terminals, whenever you want.

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: No one will be able to steal or duplicate the painting. All rights to the virtual artwork will lie with you. Sell it, destroy it, it's all up to you—

steps.name: Newbie Investor
steps.text: —This is blasphemy against art!

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: What was that, I'm blaspheming against art? Look at that grizzled, big-bellied investor beside you. If you want blasphemy, well, he's the master.

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: You people don't care what creators conceive or convey, you just want the rights to the interpretation in your greasy grip, to easily manipulate prices against market trends.

steps.name: Haughty Broker
steps.text: You do the same thing, and so does your father!

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: When have I ever tried to claim that Szczepan Kowalski does not blaspheme against art?

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: I know at a glance that the man beside you eagerly agreeing with everything you say is desperate for you to beg others to blaspheme against his art for only a prettier penny, isn't he?

spans.text: I know at a glance that the man beside you eagerly agreeing with everything you say is desperate for you to beg others to blaspheme against
art for only a prettier penny, isn't he?

steps.name: Haughty Broker
steps.text: You're mad.

steps.name: Tired Spectator
steps.text: Is arguing with the audience part of his opening ceremony?

steps.name: Enthusiastic Spectator
steps.text: Look, he made a name for himself as a maverick, you can't deny that, can you? Can you, sir?

steps.name: Enthusiastic Spectator
steps.text: Hmph, how dull. All he knows is fiddling with his terminals.

steps.name: Mateo
steps.text: Heh.

steps.name: Mateo
steps.text: (Subdued) What a surprise, this bunch isn't any better. Hypocrites.
El Capitán covers the ominous glint in the corner of his eye, and puts on an expression of indifference before anyone can cotton on to him.

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: Ladies and gentlemen, I am about to present the very first batch of CVAPs in all of Terra.
Beneath the podium, the crowd hushes for a spell.

They've had an ample taste of Reynell's zero amenity to reason, but a man without reason is still a man, one who'd naturally want to maintain the privileged life he enjoys. Or to put it another way, he needs money too.

The issue is the difference, and the difference is that the layperson who abides by the rules makes money in ways everyone can accept, and be amicable while doing it. The unreasonable sod, meanwhile, has a nasty habit of looking down on the rest while churning their cash.
But no matter. As long as the sod still seeks money, the layperson will always find a chance to pick every last scrap of the madman's innards clean.

steps.name: Newbie Investor
steps.text: (Whisper) Sir, what should we do?

steps.name: Seasoned Investor
steps.text: (Whisper) Let's see how this plays out.

steps.name: Seasoned Investor
steps.text: (Whisper) See what collectibles he can wheel out for us.

steps.name: Seasoned Investor
steps.text: (Whisper) The intercity net isn't enough to sustain a new field of investment, but there's a chance this madman can strike some actual treasure.

steps.name: Seasoned Investor
steps.text: (Whisper) We've got ways to get what we want, anyhow.

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: These pieces brim with the kindness and hospitality and brightness and sheer beauty I've come to feel during my time in Dossoles. And so, they possess the geist of commemoration, one to forever elude comparison.

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: I proudly present to you all—'El Capitán Molesto'!!

steps.name: Newbie Investor
steps.text: How... How is this worth anything?

steps.name: Haughty Broker
steps.text: You're out of your mind! A rich kid with brainrot!

steps.name: Destitute Noble
steps.text: It's over. It's all over. There's no art salon here. Why do I paint for a living...?

steps.name: Enthusiastic Spectator
steps.text: Wait, bro, that virtual artpiece or whatever, that one... I think Reynell based it on you?

steps.name: Mateo
steps.text: Me?
El Capitán stands himself up, first looking at the terminal in his hand, then at the show screen, and finally at Reynell, whose line of sight meets his.

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: Capitán Mateo, in light of how jolly our first meeting was, I have one more gift for you here.

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: You are going to be the model for the first CVAP in the entire history of Terra.

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: Come, pick one. I'd be glad to grant it to you, free of charge.
All eyes in the venue land on El Capitán.
He does not immediately respond to Reynell. His first order of business is one more glance at his terminal.
And finally, he sees the news he's been waiting for this entire time.

steps.name: Mateo
steps.text: No need, Señor Reynell. You keep it for yourself.

steps.name: Mateo
steps.text: So sorry, everyone, but I have urgent news to announce.

steps.name: Enthusiastic Spectator
steps.text: Who're you?

steps.name: Mateo
steps.text: I am a representative of the Bolívaran Coalition Government in Dossoles, señor.

steps.name: Mateo
steps.text: The latest news indicates a terrorist threat targeting the gallery is imminent. I ask you all to follow my instructions to get to safety.

steps.name: Mateo
steps.text: Reliable information suggests that rioters are charging our location at this very moment. Do please follow the soldiers under my command to shelter in the gallery.
Vague, on the horizon, are a notable number of silhouettes seemingly charging for the Galería, apparently emerging with an indistinct jumbled chorus of singing.

steps.name: Commanding Officer
steps.text: Come with me, señor.

steps.name: Seasoned Investor
steps.text: No! I need to find Candela and—

steps.name: Commanding Officer
steps.text: Not now. You, grab him.

steps.name: Officer's Subordinate
steps.text: Sir.

steps.name: Mateo
steps.text: Let's go, Reynell.

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: Mr. Mateo, you really have furnished my opening ceremony with a tremendous surprise—

steps.name: Mateo
steps.text: Men. I want you to haul him away, off to his favorite balcony to watch the sunrise. I'll have a talk with him later.

steps.name: Mateo
steps.text: Oh, also, remember to make him climb the stairs himself.

steps.name: Mateo
steps.text: Status?

steps.name: Commanding Officer
steps.text: We've managed to intimidate—sorry, convince the majority to accept our arrangements. We're relocating them to the Galería Krysztauowa interior now.

spans.text: the majority to accept our arrangements. We're relocating them to the Galería Krysztauowa interior now.

steps.name: Commanding Officer
steps.text: There's a few troublemakers unwilling to listen to us. You see...

steps.name: Mateo
steps.text: Troublemakers?

steps.name: Mateo
steps.text: Once the majority are inside, I want blades against their throats. See if they have the stomach to make trouble then.

steps.name: Commanding Officer
steps.text: Sir.

steps.name: Mateo
steps.text: What about the street art people?

steps.name: Commanding Officer
steps.text: They'll be here in a few minutes. Our plants there have succeeded in instigating them. Now we just wait for them to reach the plaza and carry out their atrocities, and they'll substantiate the terrorist attack claim.

steps.name: Mateo
steps.text: Dawn is coming. We need to hurry.

steps.name: Sly Stranger
steps.text: The gallery is just after the turn there!

steps.name: Community Hawker
steps.text: Whew, I can't wait to give Reynell a shock.

steps.name: Sly Stranger
steps.text: I like it! We'll smash up his gallery and loot every last piece of stupid crap in there!

steps.name: Community Hawker
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Community Hawker
steps.text: What's your deal?

steps.name: Sly Stranger
steps.text: What...? What's my deal? Didn't we say we were gonna go big?

steps.name: Community Hawker
steps.text: When I said go big, I meant we were gonna turn his gallery doorstep into our own arts festival and completely flip Reynell's opening ceremony. What was your idea of going big?

steps.name: Sly Stranger
steps.text: Whatever, I'll go scout ahead!

steps.name: Community Hawker
steps.text: Tecno!

steps.name: Tecno
steps.text: What's up?

steps.name: Community Hawker
steps.text: That guy there said he lives above me, but I'm not buying it—

steps.name: Tecno
steps.text: Go on...

steps.name: Tecno
steps.text: What's up?
The hawker's jaw drops wide open. He points a finger at the gallery-front plaza just a turn away.
There's a podium there, and seats, and even jackets left on those seats by the audience...
But not one person is present.
Not a one.
